messages:
deploy-bot: Started canary deploy for redwood/runtime@v3.4.1 -> prod-usw. tag=v3.4.1-canary commit=a1b2c3d traffic=1% change-window=03:00-04:00 UTC. running smoke checks.
marie-hood: On it — watching p50/p99, error-rate, 5xx.
aditya-k: Smoke runner: all green. quick check: `curl -sS https://api.prod-usw.redwood/health | jq .status` -> "ok"
ci-bot: smoke-check passed (tests/unit + integration) — artifact verified.
deploy-bot: Canary finished first window (30s). No thresholds breached. Increasing traffic -> 10%.
olivia-g: Seeing slight p50 uptick on reranker (+12ms). p99 stable. keeping eyes on it.
sre-oncall: @marie-hood flag if p99 > 500ms or error-rate > 0.5% otherwise proceed.
marie-hood: :eyes: p50 drifting back to baseline. p99 480ms, error-rate 0.12% — proceed.
deploy-bot: Scheduled ramp to 50% in 5m. Rollback will be automatic if rollback criteria met.
aditya-k: Note: pinning model-version reranker@2026-03-19 to avoid head changes during rollout.
marie-hood: Pin applied.
olivia-g: Observed transient 502 spike from host-7, logs show `upstream read timeout`.
sre-oncall: Suggest reduce canary to 25% while we triage host-7. @deploy-bot reduce to 25% now.
deploy-bot: Traffic adjusted to 25% as requested. Canary state -> degraded (monitoring).
aditya-k: Host-7 network flaps; draining it and redeploying a small network backoff tweak.
olivia-g: After drain p50/p99 back to baseline, error-rate down to 0.05%.
marie-hood: Propose lift hold and ramp to 75% then 100% in 10m if stable.
sre-oncall: Agree, proceed with staged ramp. Setting watchdog timer.
deploy-bot: Ramping to 75% started. Final ramp to 100% scheduled in +10m.
ci-bot: Release notes: Runtime v3.4.1 — fixes: 1) KV cache edge-case 2) attention-kernel fallback 3) metrics labels for cpu trace. Tag: v3.4.1
deploy-bot: Canary complete — promoted to gradual rollout. rollout_id=r-20260319-001 final_state=promoted.
marie-hood: :tada: Nice work. I'll capture a post-rollout perf snapshot and open a short follow-up doc for the host-7 mitigation.
